name: Dropdown Menu
description: An accessible dropdown menu with keyboard navigation, submenus, and portal rendering

props.trigger: React.ReactNode - button or element to trigger dropdown
props.items: DropdownItem[] - menu items with label, onClick, icon, shortcut, disabled, danger, children, divider

usage_examples: <Dropdown trigger={<Button>Actions</Button>} items={[{ label: 'Edit', icon: <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />, onClick: handleEdit }, { label: 'Duplicate', icon: <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />, onClick: handleDuplicate }, { divider: true }, { label: 'Delete', icon: <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />, danger: true, onClick: handleDelete }]} />

<Dropdown trigger={<Avatar name="User" />} items={[{ label: 'Profile', icon: <User className="w-4 h-4" /> }, { label: 'Settings', icon: <Settings className="w-4 h-4" /> }, { divider: true }, { label: 'Sign out', icon: <LogOut className="w-4 h-4" /> }]} />

design_tokens.menu: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-2xl py-1
design_tokens.item: flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5

accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys to navigate, Enter/Space to select, Escape to close
accessibility.submenu: aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on parent items
